name: glslify
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
summary: Node module system for GLSL: shaders import functions (noise, easing, blend modes) from npm packages, and the glslify CLI or bundler transform inlines them into one shader string. Build-time only, so output is a plain shader for regl, OGL or Three.js. Distinguishing strength: reusing community GLSL without copy-paste.
use_when: Reusing npm GLSL (noise, blend, easing) in regl, OGL or Three.js shaders
Inlining shader modules as a build step in a scripted pipeline
Over copy-pasted snippets when several scenes share shader code
avoid_when: Three.js projects: ShaderChunk and TSL cover modularity natively
Single small shader: inline it, no tooling needed

assessment.rationale: Slow: 7.1.1 Dec 2024, repo idle since 2022, but stable and tiny. Only tool here for npm-style GLSL modules via a CLI or bundler transform; neighbours (regl, OGL, twgl) do not compose shader code.
